calls.statement:
WITH s AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.channel_code, d.store_id, d.format, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.net_amount, f.quantity
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store d ON d.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'),
r AS (
 SELECT sales_line_id, count(*) nret, sum(refund_net) refund, sum(quantity_returned) qret, min(return_date) mind, max(return_date) maxd FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.format, s.channel_code, s.staff_purchase_flag, count(*) lines, sum(s.net_amount) sold_net, sum(r.refund) refund_net, round(100*sum(r.refund)/sum(s.net_amount),3) pct, sum(CASE WHEN r.qret>s.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) overret, sum(CASE WHEN r.nret>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) multiret, max(r.maxd) lastret
FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING(sales_line_id) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

calls.statement:
WITH p AS (SELECT period_start_date a, period_end_date b FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=2),
sales AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, d.format, f.net_amount
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store d ON d.store_key=f.store_key, p
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN p.a AND p.b AND d.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag),
sold AS (SELECT format, sum(net_amount) sold_net FROM sales GROUP BY 1),
cohort AS (SELECT s.format, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net FROM sales s JOIN fact_return_line r USING(sales_line_id) GROUP BY 1),
booked AS (
 SELECT d.format, sum(r.refund_net) booked_refund
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING(sales_line_id) JOIN dim_store d ON d.store_key=f.store_key, p
 WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN p.a AND p.b AND d.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag GROUP BY 1)
SELECT sold.format AS store_format, round(100*cohort.refund_net/sold.sold_net,2) AS return_share_pct, sold.sold_net, cohort.refund_net, round(100*booked.booked_refund/sold.sold_net,2) AS booked_in_period_pct
FROM sold JOIN cohort USING(format) JOIN booked USING(format) ORDER BY CASE sold.format WHEN 'Large' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
